reason: Grand Est has no maritime coast but has major inland navigation on the Rhine, Moselle and connected canals. The public v0.3 lacks a dedicated inland VHF block.

anfr_manual.title: Manuel CRR fluvial - version 6, mai 2025
findings: Channel 10 is the first boat-to-boat channel.
Channel 6 must not be used on the Rhine between PK 150 and 350.
Channel 20 is authorized for information-nautical service; channel 22 is authorized for information-nautical service.

ccnr_2026.title: Guide de radiocommunication pour la navigation intérieure - partie régionale Rhin et Moselle, édition 2026
findings: French Rhine: Gambsheim CARING uses channel 19.
French Rhine locks use channels 20 and 22 depending on site.
Strasbourg port north and south locks use channel 11.
French Moselle: Koenigsmacker sector uses channel 19 and the listed French locks use channel 20.

scope.reason_channel_16_not_added: ANFR reserves channel 16 for mixed inland/maritime zones; Grand Est has no maritime coast and no local Grand Est assignment requiring it was found.
scope.channel_6_special_note: RX memory retained for non-Rhine inland use; transmission/use is prohibited on the Rhine between PK 150 and 350. Public pack remains RX-only.

next_step: Build a deterministic Grand Est v0.4 internal candidate from immutable public v0.3 and the 13-memory inland VHF dataset.
